head: 4b382e5388e652308d2beca448666630ba6c332d
summary: The change replaces misleading JSON errors and retains HTTP status internally at little maintenance cost. Command output still omits the status; live rate-limit behavior and user impact remain unknown.
reasons: The focused change replaces a misleading JSON failure with a gh failure and preserves HTTP status internally. It adds no dependencies, configuration, or instruction-loading cost.
The intended users still cannot see that HTTP status: skills/shaka/scripts/shaka.rb prints only e.message, and pr_watch/command.rb does likewise. required_checks retains its generic message.
Reported validation supports the narrow repair. Review churn was one round with an exit-8 coverage nit. Live rate-limit behavior, incident frequency, and observed user benefit remain unknown.
concerns: skills/shaka/lib/shaka/github/check_list.rb preserves HTTP status only as exception metadata. The command error output omits that metadata, so agents and maintainers still cannot distinguish a rate-limit response from other lookup failures through the promised check evidence.
alternative: Keep the narrow repair and expose the parsed HTTP status in check-failure output, including required-check failures. Preserve stderr redaction and existing empty-list handling.
next_action: Revise this PR to expose the retained HTTP status in command output and add a focused assertion for that user-visible result.
